reason: Rellich compactness with p=2 on the bounded open set supplies an L^2-convergent subsequence; its limit is the weak H^1 limit, and continuity of the L^2 norm along the strongly convergent subsequence gives ||u||_2=1. This is exactly the repair of the unit-sphere weak-closure failure recorded in [T] Section 13.3 and Lemma 13.5, printed pp. 302-303. Examined the Rellich, Sobolev, weak-convergence, quotient-L^p and reverse-triangle deps and the inherited choice principles.
